senses.gloss: f.(b. h. מַחֲלֹקֶת; חָלַק)division; separation; difference, dissension, strife, faction.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 4">Gen. R. s. 4</cite> <he>למה אין כתיב … נבראת המ׳</he> why are not the words ‘that it was good’ written about the second day of creation?… Because separation was created thereon (<cite ref="Genesis 1:6">Gen. I, 6</cite>); <he>אם מ׳ שהיא לתיקונו וכ׳</he> if to a separation which was made for the establishment and settlement of the world, ‘that it was good’ cannot be applied, how much less to a separation which tends to the confusion of the world! <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:17">Ab. V, 17</cite> <he>מ׳ שהיא לשם שמים</he> a dissension which is carried on for the sake of heaven (of truth, without selfish motives).

<cite ref="Berakhot 37a:14">Ber. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>עד מתי … בין המ׳</he> how long wilt thou put thy head between contending parties, i.e. why dost thou deviate from the established rule? <cite ref="Berakhot 38b:7">Ib. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>במ׳ שנויה</he> this has been taught under a controversy of opinion.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:43">Y. Peah I, 16ᵃ</cite> <he>בעלי מ׳</he> people who create strife.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:4:3">Y. Snh. I, 19ᶜ</cite> top <he>בתחלה לא היתה מ׳ וכ׳</he> in former days there were no conflicting opinions in Israel (they being settled by the Sanhedrin); Bab.
Snh. 88ᵇ לא היו מרבין מ׳ וכ׳ they allowed no differences to spread &c.; Tosef. ib. VII, 1; Tosef. Ḥag. II, 9 מַחֲלוֹקוֹת (pl.).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 147a:10">B. Bath. 147ᵃ</cite> <he>אל תהיו במ׳</he> do not join a political faction.
<cite ref="Horayot 11b:12">Hor. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>מפני מַחֲלוֹקָתוֹ של וכ׳</he> (not <he>מחלקותו</he>) on account of the contention of Adoniyah (who claimed the right of succession).
Ib. כי איכא מ׳ בעיא וכ׳ wherever there was a contest between claimants, anointing was required; a. fr.—Pl. מַחֲלוֹקוֹת.
<cite ref="Sotah 47b:22">Sot. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>רבו מ׳ וכ׳</he> the factions in Israel became numerous. Tosef. Snh. l. c., v. supra.
<cite ref="Megillah 3a:5">Meg. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>שלא ירבו מ׳ וכ׳</he> in order that dissensions may not spread &c.; a. e.
